name: Odalys Valladares
office: City of Santa Fe Springs, Member of the City Council

items.text: Odalys Valladares is a business owner and insurance agent. She formerly served as president of the Metropolitan Little League. In 2026, the city temporarily revoked the league's field access over alleged subleasing; Valladares denied the claim and said the dispute was a result of her council campaign. She has served on the city's Parks and Recreation Advisory Committee.
